theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_cyl_suspension_map
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid N) (Gh : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (N + 1)), (∀ z, Gh z = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons (WithLp.ofLp z 0) (WithLp.ofLp (G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z))))))) → (∀ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L G → LipschitzWith (max 1 L) Gh) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (u : Euclid n), Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp (G u)))) ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (u : Euclid n), DifferentiableAt ℝ G u → (fun a => fderiv ℝ Gh (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) = Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun b => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)))))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
